summary: SOURCE_ONLY full comparator/test/checkpoint/result review requires amendment before comparison admission. One high-priority independent-validity gap admits matching malformed native answers because nativeAnswer is compared with itself; one narrower path guard incorrectly classifies an internal '..name' directory as external. Most exact source-shape, codec separation, timing and artifact-binding logic matches the frozen policy plus separately admitted source-shape addendum. Eleven helper tests are not validateRun or file-package integration proof. Original comparator, tests, policy and source were not modified or executed; no producer outputs were read.

findings.counterexample: Take any otherwise model-conforming synthetic success package, replace every queryTrace[n].nativeAnswer with literal null and every corresponding answer fragment with canonical tagged null, then recompute that package's manifest/receipt/stdout bindings. validateRun's expected nativeAnswer is the same null, fragment-to-row equality passes, codec canonicality passes, and a second identical malformed package passes cross-run answer equality. Nothing in validateRun checks a successful native answer envelope or its consistency with the expected computed emits. Yet the frozen registerQueries route cannot successfully return null: it requires value plus a string unit, then returns an object with emits:{computed:1}. This is a source-only control-flow counterexample; no package was built or run.
findings.requested_amendment: Independently validate each native answer against at least the source-known successful answer envelope and exact computed emit channel before using it as an expected value. Preserve every native measurement value exactly, including legitimate null/condition inside value. Do not ban native null measurement fields or invent measured values. Add a hand-declared full validateRun success fixture and a nativeAnswer=null mutation rejection test; also reject missing value, non-string unit and incorrect emits. Root may decide whether more query-specific source-schema evidence is required before full package admission.

findings.counterexample: For an absolute sourceRoot /repo and absolute output root /repo/..inside/original, path.relative is '..inside/original'. That string starts with '..', so the comparator accepts it as external even though it is lexically inside /repo. This requires no symlink, alias or unusual filesystem behavior. inspectDirectory does not independently enforce exclusion from the source root.
findings.requested_amendment: Use a path-component-aware containment decision: only relative '..' or a relative path beginning with '..' followed by the platform path separator, or an absolute relative result, is outside. Reject internal names starting '..' just as other internal descendants. Add a focused lexical test for '..inside/original' versus '../sibling/original'. No new production run is needed.

smallest_meaningful_missing_engineering_.check: Hand-declared full validateRun fixture with one positive source-shape case and narrowly mutated malformed cases
smallest_meaningful_missing_engineering_.why: compare.test.mjs imports and tests helper functions but never imports/calls validateRun or comparePackages. Its only matching-malformed test passes [] to validateNativeCaptures; it cannot expose F1 in the actual source-success-model validator. nativeFixture mirrors the native validator but does not exercise trace/inputIntegrity/request/source binding or answer envelopes. This targeted fixture is smaller than a new generic integration framework and contains no measured answers or source pixel data.
smallest_meaningful_missing_engineering_.next_separate_check: A later explicitly admitted synthetic full file-package check should demonstrate ordinary pretty JSON manifest/receipt parsing, tagged wire artifacts, within-run/hash/outer binding and reject a matching malformed pair. The eleven current helper tests alone must not be called integration proof. No such test was written or executed by R2.

reviewed_supported_areas: fixedDeclarations/fixedPlan and artifactModel preserve frozen literal group/window/bank/query order, 16 comparisons,160 plans,176 callback metadata/fragments and338 ordered manifest artifacts; metadata ordering agrees with legacy writer.

validateNativeCaptures preserves capture wrapper and16 native entry keys, callback order [1,0,2..10], parent/depth/caller/cache/computedMs/null details. Native elapsed is the only exempt native entry leaf.

validateTiming plus intervalMetadata enforce182 exact source-ordered interval metadata records, finite nonnegative nonnegative-zero clocks, exact elapsed=end-start, interval ordering, source rounding and nested constant<=profile. timingPaths contains exactly722 sidecar leaves, plus the176 independently scoped calculation-fragment elapsed leaves.

validateRun snapshot check objects correctly use exactly planIndex,post,verified with no error/pre; snapshot error:null remains exact. sourceBinding model correctly separates nine physical entry shapes from five implementation entry shapes, retaining first-two null expected hashes. This follows the separately admitted addendum, not an unchanged pass of defective original policy wording.

equalTree preserves Object.is numbers, object prototype/key order, dense undecorated arrays and exact Uint8Array identity/elements. No generic JSON projection, timing-name matching or sorting normalizes native wire values.

readPackage parses ordinary writer manifest/receipt with parsePrettyDocument rather than the tagged codec, binds all338 actual files before decoding, re-encodes to demand canonical wire bytes, checks within-run fragment correspondence and source-known metadata. Per-file caps use32MiB general wire,4MiB sidecar/calculation,128KiB envelope documents; unchanged codec limits remain delegated to the explicitly supplied unchanged codec namespace.

Cross-run value-trace and answer fragments are byte-exact and tree-exact. Timing files are compared before only their verified derived length/hash envelope dependencies may differ. Receipt and exact one-line stdout/empty stderr are independently modeled per run.

No top-level filesystem reads or product/recipe/CLI/codec imports are present in comparator source. comparePackages is read-only and catches failures into explicit stage FAIL/NOT_COMPARABLE with remaining stages NOT_RUN. Authenticating supplied codec namespace, outer observations/runtime and fresh/immutable chronological execution remains an explicitly disclosed root-admission responsibility, not something this source-only review proves.

policy_authority.source_shape_interpretation: Accept only the exact separately hash-bound admitted addendum reviewed by R1/R1517; its own status remains PROPOSED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW while the separate admission records acceptance.

scope.frozen_policy_and_relevant_source: Complete E1512 policy read during preceding E1517 source-only critique; exact source schema/store/codec/legacy writer blocks retained and source-reviewed; current R1515 reread store answer wrapper text. No vendor/PATH source inspected.
